name: genre-report-runner
description: Unattended issue production per DR-0168: GitHub Actions + Claude Agent SDK on the Polymath API account. No credential lives in this tree; everything arrives as environment variables from GitHub secrets/variables. DEPENDENCY PINNING: the SDK is pinned to the exact version the first clean production run used (0.3.288, Thriller Issue 003, 2026-10-01), package-lock.json records every installed package, and the workflow installs with `npm ci`, which refuses to run if the lock and package.json disagree. To upgrade: change the version here, run `npm install --package-lock-only` in runner/, and commit both files together.
